title: Reject external_projects in configuration instead of migrating it at load
description: Found in kbs-215bc6f0. The virtual-project specs expect a configuration with external_projects to fail with an error, but both runtimes migrate it with a warning and exit 0. That runtime migration also conflicts with the no-backward-compatibility policy in AGENTS.md. Scenarios tagged @wip pointing here. Work: remove the load-time migration in Rust and Python, fail with the spec's error message (identical in both), and if a migration path is needed put it in an explicit migration command, not the loader. Acceptance: the scenarios pass in both runtimes without @wip.
